title: The format page says how records are kept, then shows the kinds by stage and folder, the relations and the checks by severity, as clickable rows
when: Opens `/format`.
then: Expects the title in the page's one panel, the page's counts, the section on how records are kept, a kind row under Define, Capabilities leading to its page, the relations by their words, and the checks under Errors and Warnings leading to their pages.

title: The use case kind's format page opens in the workbench like any other page
when: Opens the use case kind's page.
then: Expects its description, stage and folder, parent link, each column with its type, requirement and anchor, the ID convention and obligation, links out and in by their labels, the checks that concern it, an example record and its records by parent.

title: A kind page shows where the kind sits, its columns, its links in and out by their labels, its checks, an example and its records
when: Opens the use case kind's page.
then: Expects its description, stage and folder, parent link, each column with its type, requirement and anchor, the ID convention and obligation, links out and in by their labels, the checks that concern it, an example record and its records by parent.

title: The pages are built from the loaded data: a check with no row in the check table is the engine's own, listed without an explanation
when: Opens `/format` and an engine problem's check page.
then: Expects only reads requested (GET /api/spec, and the Changes baseline), the engine's check listed, and its page saying the engine reports it itself, with its problems.

title: Format addresses parse to their pages
when: Parses `/format`, a kind's address, a check's address and an unknown one.

title: A check page shows its severity, explanation and query, and its problems now as clickable rows
when: Opens a check's page.
then: Expects its summary, rendered explanation, query and its problems as clickable rows, with the check's facts; a check that reports nothing says so, and an unknown check or kind says it is not in the format.

title: The Changes panel lists the changes newest first by record, and a click focuses the record with the panel open
The Changes panel's toggle counts the records changed
The Checks panel lists its product's problems, errors first, grouped by check
then: Checks the space's error and warning totals, its groups by check with errors before warnings, each problem's link to its record, then the workspace's problem under Workspace, opening its check, and none of the other product's.

title: Each Checks panel lists only its product's problems, then the workspace's
when: Opens.
then: Checks from the nav in Notebook and in Demo shop and expects each at its product's address with only its own problems, then the workspace's under Workspace, and no filter.

title: Selecting a problem focuses its record on the stage and in the wiki card, and the panel stays open with its row marked
then: Expects the record's address with the panel kept, the wiki card on the record, its problem's row marked, a workspace problem opening its check's page in the card, and Escape closing the card's page, then the panel.

title: Each problem code on the Checks, domain and record pages links to its check's page
when: Opens a record page, a domain page, the Checks panel and a group page.
then: Expects the Kind row and a column label to link to the kind's page and its column, each problem code to its check's page, and a group's kind to its page.

title: The space stays current on its own Checks panel
then: Expects the product of product, domain, record, group and Checks panels and none for the products and the format, the mark and accent bar on the current space, and the space kept on its Checks panel.

title: Checks opened from the nav in each space sits at that product's address
when: Opens.
then: Checks from the nav in Notebook and in Demo shop and expects each at its product's address with only its own problems, then the workspace's under Workspace, and no filter.

title: The Checks panel lists its recorded exceptions in their own section, never as problems
given: A product with a command and a repository that each record an exception.
when: Its Checks panel opens.
then: A Recorded exceptions section links the command or repository and the aggregate and gives the reason, and the totals count no warning for them.

title: The product page shows each domain as a card with its coverage bars and counts
when: Opens a product with two domains.
then: Checks one card per domain, linking to the domain page, with requirement and rule bars drawn to their share and labeled with their counts.

title: Coverage shows designed, built and proved on the product and domain pages
then: Checks the designed, built and proved counts of each domain on the product page's cards and on the domain page, a count of zero included.

title: The product page lists its open questions with owners, and its problems
then: Checks that the product page lists the product's open questions with their owners and what they are about, and only that product's problems, errors first.

title: The product page sums up the product's coverage, open questions and problems
when: Opens a product.
then: Checks its Summary's designed, built and proved totals, its open questions, errors and warnings; then opens a product with no obligations and checks its counts are zero.

title: The summary counts every obligation kind, and planned apart from proved
then: Expects the Summary's designed, built and proved totals over all four obligation kinds and a separate Planned line.

title: The summary counts the product's tests by state, and planned beside proof
then: Expects the Summary's Tests row to total its domains and its Planned row to add `; 1 more planned beside proof`, with the proved count unchanged.

title: Each domain's coverage shows its tests by state, on the product and domain pages
then: Expects `Tests 1 automated, 1 manual, 1 planned` on a domain card and on the domain page, with the planned count explained as not proof.

title: The product page lists its business outcomes first, each with its statement, measure, target and the capabilities that serve it
then: Expects both outcomes in order, each a card opening the outcome, with their statement, measure and target, the serving capability linked, the unserved one saying so, the section before Domains, and nothing of discovery in Shared.

title: An open spec page reloads the data when the server reports spec:changed
when: Opens a record page, changes the served workspace, sends `spec:changed`.
then: Checks that the page fetches the workspace again and shows the new title at the same address.

title: The wiki card's handle moves with the arrow, Home and End keys within its limits, and the nav has one too
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage and steps the wiki card's handle with Home, Left and End.
then: Expects the wiki card at 360, 376 and 900 px (Left grows it, as it sits after its handle), and a handle for the navigation.

title: The nav's handle steps with the arrow keys, Shift, Home and End
when: Steps the navigation's gap with Right, Shift and Left, and End.
then: Expects the stored and applied width, resets it by double-click.

title: A panel's size is remembered, and double-clicking its handle resets it
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage, moves the wiki card's handle to End, and double-clicks it.
then: Expects the wiki card's 900 px saved in the session settings and reset to a third of the open space.

title: A panel's stepped width is stored, and double-clicking its handle resets it
when: Steps the navigation's gap with Right, Shift and Left, and End.
then: Expects the stored and applied width, resets it by double-click.

title: A remembered nav width comes back, and an out-of-range one falls back to the default
when: Starts with a remembered navigation width, then an out-of-range one.
then: Expects the first kept and the second back to its default; on a narrow screen expects no resize handles.

title: On a narrow screen there are no resize handles
when: Starts with a remembered navigation width, then an out-of-range one.
then: Expects the first kept and the second back to its default; on a narrow screen expects no resize handles.

title: On the Graph stage the wiki card and the header strip show the focused record, and its toggle brings the card back
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage.
then: Expects the wiki card open with the use case's name, the header strip naming it too, and after the card is collapsed its toggle at the right of the page bar bringing it back.

title: A theme previewed or kept from Color theme applies at once, without a reload
when: Opens the picker with g then t, arrows to Workshop.
then: Expects it shown but not kept, Escape to put Lathe back, then filters to Midnight and keeps it with Enter, remembered with its stylesheet and announced.

title: The early script puts the chosen theme and mode on the page before the app runs
when: Runs the inline script from index.html with a stored stylesheet, theme and mode.
then: Expects them on the page, and with nothing stored expects the stylesheet's own Lathe theme following the system.

title: Every command has a title, and no binding clashes or takes a browser key
then: Checks every row of the keymap for a unique id, a title and a group, the VS Code defaults (quick open, the palette, the nav, Ctrl+G or Ctrl+1 for the Graph stage, w or Ctrl+W for the wiki card, F8), and no command for the old views, maximize or full screen.

title: Mod is Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere
when: Normalizes and shows bindings for both platforms, turns key events into chords (physical keys with modifiers, characters without), and matches chords and sequences.

title: Ctrl+P and Ctrl+K open quick find
when: Presses Ctrl+P.
then: Expects the event prevented and quick find open over the page with its box focused; closes it, collapses the nav and expects Ctrl+K to open it with the nav left collapsed; expects an unhandled Ctrl key left alone.

title: Ctrl+B hides and shows the nav
when: Presses each twice.
then: Expects the rail and the nav back, and the announcements.

title: Off a Mac, Alt+G, Alt+E and Alt+T or Ctrl+1, 2 and 3 switch the stage, and Enter and Alt+W collapse and show the wiki card
when: Off a Mac, opens a use case and presses Ctrl+2, Alt+T, Ctrl+1, Alt+E, Ctrl+3 and Alt+G, then Enter and Alt+W, then the old maximize keys.
then: Expects the address to name the ERD, Trace, Graph, ERD, Trace and Graph stages in turn, the wiki card hidden by Enter and back with Alt+W, and no pane or full screen anywhere.

title: F8 and Shift+F8 move through the problems, wrapping around
when: On the.
then: Checks panel, steps forward and back through the problems, wrapping around, and expects each one announced.

title: g then c, f or h jumps to Checks, the format or home, with a hint while waiting
when: Presses g then c, f and h.
then: Expects Checks, the format and home, the hint while waiting, and nothing while typing in quick find.

title: In the graph, + and - change the depth and . frames the focus again, and no key turns a trace on
when: Presses + and -.
then: Expects the depth to change, presses . on a domain's graph and expects it still the center, finds no command to open or fold a group in place, and finds no trace command among the graph's.

title: F12, Shift+F12, Ctrl+Shift+E, / and Ctrl+- move focus and history
when: Opens a focused link with F12, opens the wiki card's whole page at its incoming links with Shift+F12, focuses the nav, focuses quick find or the page search with /, and goes back with Ctrl+-.

title: The stage switch has Ctrl+G, Ctrl+E and Ctrl+T on a Mac and Alt+G, Alt+E and Alt+T elsewhere, then Ctrl+1, 2 and 3, and the wiki card Enter and Ctrl+W or Alt+W
when: Resolves the keymap for a Mac and for other platforms.
then: Expects Enter and Ctrl+W for the wiki card on a Mac and Enter and Alt+W elsewhere, Escape to collapse it, no single letter on W, A, S or D but the graph's steps, and Ctrl+G or Ctrl+1, Ctrl+E or Ctrl+2 and Ctrl+T or Ctrl+3 for the Graph, ERD and Trace stages on a Mac, Alt instead of Ctrl for the letters elsewhere.

title: Single-key shortcuts never fire while typing
then: Expects inputs, text areas and editable text to count as typing and checkboxes and buttons not to, and single keys to be told apart from chords, function keys and Escape.

title: Ctrl+P never opens the print dialog, and an unhandled Ctrl key reaches the browser
when: Presses Ctrl+P.
then: Expects the event prevented and quick find focused; collapses the nav and expects Ctrl+K to open it; expects an unhandled Ctrl key left alone.

title: g then c, f or h does nothing while typing in quick find
when: Presses g then c, f and h.
then: Expects Checks, the format and home, the hint while waiting, and nothing while typing in quick find.

title: Bindings can be overridden in local storage, never onto a browser key
when: Stores overrides.
then: Expects unknown commands and local keys ignored, a browser essential dropped, the new binding matched, and bad JSON ignored.

title: The shortcuts sheet says how to override a binding
when: Opens the sheet with ?
then: Expects its groups, a shortcut, the override note and the search; expects ? typed into a search box; opens the palette, filters to Graph stage on or off, runs it, and finds Expand all and Collapse all.

title: Hiding or showing the nav by keyboard is announced
when: Presses each twice.
then: Expects the rail and the nav back, and the announcements.

title: A stage switched by a key is announced, and so is the wiki card collapsed or shown
when: Opens a use case, presses Ctrl+2, then Enter twice.
then: Expects the announcer to say "ERD stage", then "Wiki card collapsed", then "Wiki card shown".

title: Each problem F8 or Shift+F8 moves to is announced
when: On the.
then: Checks panel, steps forward and back through the problems, wrapping around, and expects each one announced.

title: Off a Mac, a stage button's aria-keyshortcuts lists Alt+G or Alt+E first
then: Expects `aria-keyshortcuts` on the nav toggle, quick find, the spaces, Checks, the view toggles (Alt+W and Alt+G first, off a Mac), the depth buttons and full screen (Ctrl+3), and none for a sequence.

title: A key means the platform's own key, and an override to Ctrl+W or Ctrl+G is dropped off a Mac
when: Resolves the keymap for a Mac and for other platforms.
then: Expects Ctrl+W to toggle the wiki card on a Mac but not Cmd+W, Alt+G to switch to the Graph stage elsewhere but not Ctrl+G, an override to Ctrl+W or Ctrl+G dropped off a Mac, and no binding reserved on its platform.

title: A tooltip shows a control's name and keys after a hover delay, and at once on keyboard focus
then: Expects no tooltip at once on hover, the tooltip after the delay, one at once on keyboard focus, Escape and leaving closing it, and none on a click.

title: Keys are shown as the platform shows them
when: Formats bindings for a Mac and elsewhere, then on a Mac.
then: Expects ⌘B, ⌥⌘B and ⌥1 in tooltips, ⌘P in quick find and ⌘\ in the palette.

title: Every control with a shortcut has aria-keyshortcuts
then: Expects `aria-keyshortcuts` on the nav toggle, quick find, the spaces, Checks, the stage switch's buttons (Alt+G and Alt+E first, off a Mac), the wiki card toggle (W and Alt+W) and the depth buttons, and none for a sequence.

title: A rebinding changes every hint
when: Overrides two bindings.
then: Expects the navigation toggle's tooltip, `aria-keyshortcuts`, its palette row and its shortcuts sheet row to show Ctrl+J, and the Graph stage button's and its sheet row to show Alt+G.

title: A click opens no tooltip, and Escape or leaving the control closes one
then: Expects no tooltip at once on hover, the tooltip after the delay, one at once on keyboard focus, Escape and leaving closing it, and none on a click.

title: A phone shows a compact top bar with the title, a step up and quick find, and the header strip over the stage
when: On a phone, with Trace remembered for a wide screen, opens a use case with `?stage=graph`, switches to the ERD stage and opens the wiki card.
then: Expects the top bar's menu, title, "Up to Lending" link keeping `?stage=graph` and quick find; the header strip and the Graph stage with no wiki card and no resize handle; the stage switch holding Graph, ERD and Trace; ERD switching to `?stage=erd` with Trace still remembered; and the wiki card opening as a half-height bottom sheet.

title: No page scrolls sideways at 320 px
when: Reads the stylesheet for any fixed least width over 288 px outside a wide-screen query.
then: Checks that tables and code blocks scroll in their own box and that IDs wrap, and renders the product, domain, record, component, checks and format pages on a phone expecting every table and code block in a scrolling box and no inline width over 288 px. jsdom lays nothing out, so the real widths are checked in a browser at 320 and 375 px.

title: A phone shows the stage filling the screen, switched from the page bar, and the wiki card as a bottom sheet
when: On a phone, with Trace remembered for a wide screen, opens a use case with `?stage=graph`, switches to the ERD stage and opens the wiki card.
then: Expects the Graph stage with no wiki card and no resize handle, the stage switch holding Graph, ERD and Trace, ERD switching to `?stage=erd` with Trace still remembered, and the wiki card opening as a half-height bottom sheet.

title: The nav is a full-screen sheet that keeps Tab inside it
when: On a phone, opens the nav.
then: Expects the sheet, Tab from its last control going to its first and Shift+Tab from its first to its last.

title: On a phone every clickable control, the nav sheet's rows among them, is sized for a thumb
when: Reads `app/src/styles.css`.
then: Expects every rule with a pointer cursor to be covered by a coarse-pointer rule that sizes the control (or a `::before` stretched around it) to `--touch-target` (44 px), or to be touch-sized everywhere; canvas nodes and cards are exempt, being laid out large and zoomable.

title: The wiki card is a bottom sheet: it opens at half height with focus inside, its handle takes it to full height and back, Escape closes it and focus returns
when: On a phone, opens the wiki card from the page bar.
then: Expects a modal bottom sheet at half height with the wiki card focused, full height and back from the handle, Tab kept inside, and Escape closing it with focus back on the button.

title: A drag on a sheet's handle settles by distance and speed
then: Checks `settle`: up to full height, a short drag staying put, a flick up, down to half from full, away from half by a long drag or a flick, and away from full by a very long drag.

title: The open pages are a sheet from the page bar
when: On a phone, opens the Open pages sheet, keeps the preview tab from its row, opens another page.
then: Expects two rows with the active one marked and focused; choosing a row goes there and closes the sheet; a row's close button closes its tab.

title: Quick find on a phone is a full-width sheet at the top
when: On a phone, opens quick find from the top bar.
then: Expects a dialog with the box focused, a Close button, the results under it, a choice going to the record and closing the sheet, and Escape closing it with focus back on the button.

title: On a touch screen a first tap on a graph node selects it and shows its card
when: On a touch screen, taps a graph node on the canvas.
then: Expects the address unchanged, the node drawn as selected and its box in the keyboard layer outlined, and a card naming it; a tap on the canvas away from every box lets go; the card is one button named for opening the node, beside the let go button, and a tap on it opens the node. `isTap` reads a mouse as a click and a finger or a pen as a tap.

title: On a phone long IDs wrap, and tables and code blocks scroll in their own box
when: Reads the stylesheet for any fixed least width over 288 px outside a wide-screen query.
then: Checks that tables and code blocks scroll in their own box and that IDs wrap, and renders the product, domain, record, component, checks and format pages on a phone expecting every table and code block in a scrolling box and no inline width over 288 px. jsdom lays nothing out, so the real widths are checked in a browser at 320 and 375 px.

title: The theme-color meta follows the theme's --sheet token
when: Sets `--sheet` on the root.
then: Expects the meta to take it, changes it and expects the meta to follow.

title: On a touch screen every workbench target is at least 44 × 44 px, at any width
when: Reads `app/src/styles.css`.
then: Expects every rule with a pointer cursor to be covered by a coarse-pointer rule that sizes the control (or a `::before` stretched around it) to `--touch-target` (44 px), or to be touch-sized everywhere; canvas nodes and cards are exempt, being laid out large and zoomable.

title: Stability: the first load of the product, domain and record pages shifts nothing, also with slow fonts
when: Loads each page with the probes installed before its scripts, and once with the app's font files held back 2.5 seconds.
then: Expects no unexpected shift and the nav, the page bar, the header strip, the wiki card and the stage never to move.

title: Stability: moving between records through the nav, a link in the wiki card, a click on the stage, Back and quick find keeps the frame still
when: Moves between records each way.
then: Expects the frame not to move; from a page scrolled half-way, expects the new page never to be drawn at the old scroll, and Back to draw the page once, with the row that was at the top of the view back in its place.

title: Stability: switching the stage and collapsing, hiding or resizing a panel moves only it, the panels never overlap, and the focus recenters in the open space
when: At 1024 px with every panel open, measures the panels; switches the stage with Ctrl+2; collapses and shows the wiki card with Enter; widens the wiki card from the keyboard.
then: Expects the panels side by side with no overlap and the stage filling the window behind them; on each step only the stage, or the panel moved, to change, the other panels to stay, and the focus to sit in the open space afterwards.

title: Stability: folding a row and Expand all move only what is below
when: Opens and closes a row and uses Expand all and Collapse all in the wiki card on the domain page.
then: Expects the row, the section heading, the title and the frame to stay.

title: Stability: dragging a panel's edge follows the pointer, and folding by drag moves nothing on the far side
when: Drags the nav's and the wiki card's edges and folds the nav by drag.
then: Expects the panel dragged never to jump back, and the stage and the other panels not to move.

title: Stability: re-centering the graph at depth 1 to 3, changing depth and moving around the ERD keep the panels, the stage's tools and the canvas still
when: Re-centers twice at each depth, changes the depth, and goes from a domain's ERD to an aggregate's and an entity's and back.
then: Expects the page bar, the header strip, the stage's toolbar and the canvas never to move or remount; the boxes the camera brings into view are drawn inside the canvas.

title: Stability: a live reload keeps what is in view
when: Changes a data file in the suite's copy of the data while the domain page's wiki card is scrolled half-way (a paragraph added to the domain's description, above the view) and while the Graph stage shows (a paragraph added to the record's goal).
then: Expects what was at the top of the view to stay there, the scroll box to keep its place, and the frame and the graph not to be drawn anew.

title: Stability: tooltips, quick find, the palette and the shortcuts sheet are placed before they show
when: Hovers the stage switch's buttons, types in quick find, the command palette and the shortcuts sheet.
then: Expects each to stay where it showed and the page behind not to move.

title: Stability: switching theme moves nothing
when: Switches from the default theme to Midnight through the Color theme pick (g t) on a record page on the Graph stage.
then: Expects no layout shift at all and no key element to move.

title: Stability: the mobile sheets at 375 px move nothing behind them
when: At 375 px wide with touch, opens and closes the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the wiki card sheet.
then: Expects the top bar, the page and its title behind them not to move.

title: Performance: a record page is interactive within 1.5 s
when: Opens a record page three times on a warm server.
then: Expects the median time from navigation until its title is drawn and the long frames after it have ended to be under 1.5 s.

title: Performance: a view switch takes under 100 ms of main-thread work
when: On a record page, opens and closes the Graph pane (after a first open has loaded its code).
then: Expects each switch to take under 100 ms of main-thread work.

title: Performance: a graph re-center at depth 3 takes under 500 ms of main-thread work and glides at 60 Hz
when: In the Tree layout at depth 3 and in the Nested layout (which has no depth), re-centers three times on boxes in view.
then: Expects each re-center, from the click until the glide has ended, to take under 500 ms of main-thread work, at most 3 of its frames to take more than 20 ms and none 100 ms or more; prints each re-center's work, its longest frame and how many frames took over 20 ms.

title: Performance: opening the ERD pane takes under 100 ms of main-thread work
when: On an aggregate, opens the ERD pane once (loading its code and ELK, measured without a budget), closes it, opens it again.
then: Expects that switch to take under 100 ms of main-thread work; measures how long the ERD map takes to be drawn after a domain's page.

title: The first load reaches no React Flow and no ELK through static imports, so a record page opens on the wiki's code alone
when: Follows the static imports from the app's entry.
then: Expects no module of React Flow or ELK among them.

title: Stability: the nav, the first pane's bar and title never move while a page first loads
when: Loads each page with the probes installed before its scripts, and once with the app's font files held back 2.5 seconds.
then: Expects no unexpected shift and the nav, the page and the first pane's bar and title never to move.

title: The header strip's count is one text, so a new number never moves the text after it
when: Opens a requirement on the Graph stage at depth 1.
then: Expects the header strip's counts to be one text node, the last thing in the strip, and no count in the graph's toolbar.

title: Every scroll box keeps room for its scrollbar, so it never comes and goes with the content
when: Reads `app/src/styles.css`.
then: Expects more than five vertical scroll boxes, each setting `scrollbar-gutter: stable` or hiding its scrollbar, and names the line of any that does not.

title: Accessibility: every page and state passes axe at WCAG 2.2 AA, at both widths, in every look
when: Opens each page and state (the product, domain, record and group pages, the graph, the ERD stage.
then: Checks, Format, Appearance, quick find, the palette, the shortcuts sheet, a tooltip, the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the wiki card sheet) at 1440 px and 375 px, in Lathe and High contrast, light and dark, and expects axe-core to find nothing.

title: Accessibility: Tab reaches every control and comes back round, with no trap
when: On a record page on the Graph stage, with the wiki card open, presses Tab until focus comes back to its first stop.
then: Expects it to get there, every stop to be drawn, and Shift+Tab to go back the same way.

title: Accessibility: the main tasks are done by keyboard alone, from the skip link to the theme
when: With the keyboard only: follows the skip link, opens a record from the nav and from quick find, turns the Graph stage on and off from the page bar, moves between the graph's boxes and re-centers on one, steps out and in with Left and Right in the Tree view and with Up and Down in the Nested view, folds and unfolds a row, collapses and shows the wiki card, and picks the Midnight theme.
then: Expects the announcer to say "Graph stage", "Wiki card collapsed", "Wiki card shown" and "Color theme: Midnight".

title: Accessibility: focus after a move, and back on the opener when a dialog or a sheet closes
then: Expects focus to stay on the page after quick find opens a record, to stay on a view toggle and the wiki card toggle after they are pressed, and to follow the box that became the graph's center. Opens the palette, the shortcuts sheet and the theme picker, expects focus inside each and Tab to stay inside, and expects focus back on the opener when each closes; at 375 px does the same for the nav drawer and the wiki card sheet.

title: Accessibility: a view, the wiki card and a theme changed by keyboard are each announced
when: With the keyboard only: follows the skip link, opens a record from the nav and from quick find, turns the Graph stage on and off from the page bar, moves between the graph's boxes and re-centers on one, folds and unfolds a row, collapses and shows the wiki card, and picks the Midnight theme.
then: Expects the announcer to say "Graph stage", "Wiki card collapsed", "Wiki card shown" and "Color theme: Midnight".

title: Accessibility: axe finds every control's name holding its visible text, on every page and state
when: Opens each page and state (the product, domain, record and group pages, the graph, the ERD stage.
then: Checks, Format, Appearance, quick find, the palette, the shortcuts sheet, a tooltip, the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the wiki card sheet) at 1440 px and 375 px, in Lathe and High contrast, light and dark, and expects axe-core to find nothing.

title: Accessibility: axe finds no control inside another, on every page and state
when: Opens each page and state (the product, domain, record and group pages, the graph, the ERD stage.
then: Checks, Format, Appearance, quick find, the palette, the shortcuts sheet, a tooltip, the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the wiki card sheet) at 1440 px and 375 px, in Lathe and High contrast, light and dark, and expects axe-core to find nothing.

title: Accessibility: axe finds every scrolling box reachable by keyboard, on every page and state
when: Opens each page and state (the product, domain, record and group pages, the graph, the ERD stage.
then: Checks, Format, Appearance, quick find, the palette, the shortcuts sheet, a tooltip, the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the wiki card sheet) at 1440 px and 375 px, in Lathe and High contrast, light and dark, and expects axe-core to find nothing.

title: Accessibility: axe finds every target at least 24 px or clear of its neighbors, on every page and state
when: Opens each page and state (the product, domain, record and group pages, the graph, the ERD stage.
then: Checks, Format, Appearance, quick find, the palette, the shortcuts sheet, a tooltip, the nav drawer, the quick find sheet and the wiki card sheet) at 1440 px and 375 px, in Lathe and High contrast, light and dark, and expects axe-core to find nothing.

title: Stages and folders fold one level at a time, each with its count
then: Expects the space's domains folded by default; a domain opening into Define, Design and Open questions with counts; each stage opening into its folders, still folded; and a folder listing its records.

title: A stage or folder with no records is left out of the nav
then: Expects a domain with an aggregate, a use case and its flow to show Domain model, Use cases and Interaction design, no Technical specification or Test plan, and its Interaction design to list Flows and no empty Endpoints folder.

title: The current page's branch opens itself
then: Expects a requirement's page to open its use case's folder, a component's page Technical specification with the component marked, a group page its kind's folder and its eyebrow to name Design › Interaction design, and a domain page its domain.

title: The product shows Shared only when it has patterns
then: Expects Shared with the product's pattern, no Patterns group, a pattern rule's page opening Shared, and no Shared for a product without patterns.

title: A capability's flows and tests sit in their folders, its use cases under it
then: Expects each folder's records, with a capability's flow and test lifted into Interaction design and Test plan; the domain page's Use cases headed Capabilities, then Use cases outside any capability; and a capability's use case opening its capability's branch.

title: In the nav, Technical specification and Test plan fold into kind folders with counts, one level at a time, folded for the session
then: Expects each stage to open into its kind folders with counts, still folded, a kind folder's row to only fold, and what is open kept in session storage only.

title: A test's or a technical record's page opens its branch through its stage and kind folder
then: Expects an invariant test's page to open Invariant tests with its row current, and a table's page Tables.

title: Records with no owner sit in the one domain that uses them, or else in Shared by stage, and a specification in its domain's Domain model
when: Opens the product's page and nav, then a domain's page.
then: Expects the value object both domains use in the product's Shared, in the nav and on the product page; the view and integration one domain uses in its Interaction design; and the specification in its Domain model.

title: The product page lists the records it shares under Shared, in their stages, each in its stage's color
when: Opens the product page of a product whose two domains use one value object and one view.
then: Expects Shared to list them in the domain model and interaction design stages, in those stages' colors, and none of a domain's own records.

title: The rail shows with two or more products; with one there is none, and the product heads the nav
when: Opens the app on a workspace of three products, then on one of a single product, expanded and collapsed.
then: Expects the rail with three; with one no rail and no space list, the product's name and icon as the nav's first row, and the collapsed nav's buttons with no spaces.

title: A product's and a domain's one page, at its ID, shows its text, its facts, its links both ways and its problems
when: Opens a product and a domain at their IDs.
then: Expects its text in the wiki, the parent, data file, links out, links in and problems in the wiki card, and no link to a second overview page.

title: The domain page groups records by stage and folder, with rules and requirements nested
then: Checks the Define stage's folders (Domain model, with aggregates and their rules nested; Use cases, with requirements nested) and the Design stage's folders (Interaction design, holding flows, views and endpoints under their own headings; Technical specification; Test plan), in that order, with their key fields.

title: The search box filters records by ID or title as you type
when: Types a title fragment and an ID fragment into the search box.
then: Checks which records stay shown, then clears it and checks that every record is back.

title: The domain page lists its coverage gaps and its problems
then: Checks the coverage gaps, each with the link that is missing, the "not proved" tag on the record's row, and the domain's problems, errors first and no other domain's.

title: A group page opens the folder of its kind, and its breadcrumb names its stage as the nav does
then: Expects a requirement's page to open its use case's folder, a component's page Technical specification with the component marked, a group page its kind's folder and the header strip's breadcrumb to name Interaction design, and a domain page its domain.

title: Folder names and order come from the schema sections, in the nav and on the domain page alike
then: Expects a renamed and reordered folder to show with its new name and place in both the nav and the domain page's headings.

title: The domain page heads its use cases with Capabilities, then the use cases outside any
then: Expects each folder's records, with a capability's flow and test lifted into Interaction design and Test plan; the domain page's Use cases headed Capabilities, then Use cases outside any capability; and a capability's use case opening its capability's branch.

title: A domain's Technical specification lists its records by technical kind in the plan's order, each with what it names in code
then: Expects the kind headings in the plan's order, a repository's row with its file and a table's with its name and storage.

title: A domain's Test plan lists its tests by test kind in the plan's order, each with its run by
then: Expects the test kind headings in the plan's order, and each test's level, file when automated, and state.

title: The domain page heads Technical specification and Test plan with the nav's kind folders, in its order
then: Expects the domain page's kind headings of both stages to be the nav's kind folders, with their counts, in the same order.

title: A stage's group page of tests reads them in the same kind groups
then: Expects the Test plan group page to head its tests by Invariant tests and Use case tests, with their counts.

title: An endpoint sits in its domain's Interaction design and an integration in the one domain that uses it, by their stage
when: Builds a domain's folders and the graph's tree.
then: Expects Interaction design to hold the flow, the view, the endpoints and the integration, and the graph to place the endpoint and the integration in that stage's kind folders.

title: Coverage shows one group per obligation kind with designed, built, proved and planned
when: Serves a workspace whose coverage has four obligation kinds, one of them a product's own.
then: Expects four labeled groups in the engine's order on the domain card and the domain page, each with designed, built, proved and planned, and a planned bar that is never drawn full.

title: Coverage shows the pattern rule line
then: Expects the domain's coverage to show the pattern rule line with its counts, and gaps naming the rule.

title: The domain page lists interaction requirements under their view, endpoint or flow
then: Expects interaction requirements nested under their view and endpoint, a product's own obligation kind nested under the endpoint, gap badges on their rows, nothing left under "Other records", and a search that keeps the endpoint above the matching interaction requirement.

title: The domain page tags each test with its state, and a planned test looks unfinished
then: Expects the tags automated (for a test with no state), manual and planned, and only the planned test's row and tag marked planned, with a title saying it does not count as proof.

title: A domain follows the patterns its use cases follow
then: Checks which patterns a domain follows, which domains follow a pattern, a pattern's settings, and how a follower's not-applicable reason is read.

title: A rule is designed, built and proved per domain
then: Expects the same rule designed, built and proved in one domain, and in another designed by a component whose file is missing and proved only by a planned test, each by records of that domain only.

title: The domain page lists the patterns it follows
when: Opens a domain page.
then: Expects its followed pattern with the following use case, the rules folded under it, and per rule its designed, built, proved and planned marks.

title: A domain that follows no pattern says so
when: Opens a domain with no following use case.
then: Expects the section to say so.

title: A pattern the domain itself follows is listed, followed by the whole domain, and every rule applies
when: Makes a domain follow a pattern directly.
then: Expects the pattern among the domain's followed patterns with no use cases, a rule with a setting still applying, and its row on the domain page reading "followed by the whole domain".

title: A rule whose test's file does not exist is not proved, as coverage says
when: Loads a product through the engine whose pattern rule test is automated and names a file that does not exist, then adds that file.
then: Expects coverage to list no proof for the rule and the domain page's pattern list to say not proved, matching coverage's 0 proved; once the file exists and names the test, both say proved.

title: Whether a rule applies in a domain is the engine's answer
when: Loads workspaces through the engine where a rule is owed, not applicable through a use case's setting, waived by its applies-when condition, and owed by a domain that follows the pattern itself.
then: Expects, for every following domain and rule, the page's status, the Traceability owing domains and the domain page's mark to match the standing coverage gives.

title: A rule can be not applicable in one domain and owed in another
then: Expects a rule naming a setting to be not applicable where every following use case marks it so, with the reasons, and owed where one gives a value.

title: Not applicable shows its use case and reason
then: Expects a not applicable rule to show the use case as a link and its reason, beside a rule the domain proves.

title: A rule no follower meets shows as Waived here, with the value given, and the gaps leave it out
then: Expects a rule that applies when the record is a basket to apply where a use case gives " Basket " and to read "Waived here: record is Payment" on the domain page and the rule page of a domain that gives Payment, whose Traceability lists only the owing domain; a domain that follows the pattern itself and gives the value meets it.

title: Every record ID a page shows is a real link to that record
when: Opens every product, domain, record.
then: Checks panel of the fixture and checks that each record ID shown sits in an `<a href>` to that record's page.

title: Folded rows open by button or arrow keys and stay open after visiting another page
when: On a domain page.
then: Expects use cases and aggregates folded with their counts, opens and closes a row by button and by the arrow keys (moving into it and back to its parent), uses Expand all, and expects open rows still open after visiting another page.

title: A record page's wiki lists its children one level deep
when: Opens a domain's page.
then: Expects its records listed in their folders with their children folded, a record page whose wiki lists its children, and a product page that lists its domains but none of their records.

title: A folded use case or aggregate keeps its count of records
when: On a domain page.
then: Expects use cases and aggregates folded with their counts, opens and closes a row by button and by the arrow keys (moving into it and back to its parent), uses Expand all, and expects open rows still open after visiting another page.

title: A record ID named in text does not appear in the graph
then: Expects only the named ID linked beside a longer ID, no such link in the graph, and a domain overview that links the records its text names.

title: IDs in code blocks, code with other text, links and longer IDs are not linked; a lone-ID code span is
then: Expects no links for IDs in code blocks, code spans with other text, links or longer IDs, a link around a code span holding one lone ID, and HTML left unchanged when there is nothing to link.

title: A row that leads to one record is one link: every record row on the domain and record pages has exactly one row link, stretched over the row
when: Renders a domain page and a record page.
then: Expects every row of every `record-list` (each tree item's own row, and each plain row) that holds a record link to have exactly one `row-link`, a real link to a record's page. Reads `app/src/styles.css` and expects the `row-link` `::after` to be absolute with `inset: 0`, the rows to be `position: relative`, the row's other controls to sit above it with a `z-index`, and the link to give the row a hover tint and a focus ring.

title: No page shows a relation code as a heading or label
when: Opens every record of a workspace with a record of each kind.
then: Expects no heading, field label, table header, legend, label or caption to read as a relation code ("satisfies", "proves", "depends on", "proves this"), and the graph's edge and key labels and the ERD stage's line titles to read the meta-model's labels.

title: Pages only read GET /api/spec and the Changes baseline until the person acts: the record actions are the only controls that lead to a write, and opening a page or searching it sends none
when: Opens every spec page, types in its search boxes, and looks for forms, inputs and buttons before any record action is chosen.
then: Expects no form, editor or input but the search boxes and the stage's own view controls (the Changes baseline picker among them), every button a plain button, the only buttons that lead to a write inside the record's Change toolbar, and no request but GET /api/spec and GET /api/baseline.

title: Saving an edited draft sends one write, the page's only change to data
when: Turns an edited draft into commands.
then: Expects one write holding only a set of the changed columns, a move when the parent changed, the links taken and added, and the part rows written again.

title: A list of children or members of one kind is titled by that kind
then: Expects an aggregate's page to title its children "Domain rules", with the list named "Domain rules of DM-SHOP-A1"; a row's nested list to be named by its kind; a product's mixed children, in its wiki page, to stay "Children", tagged by kind; a group's members on the wiki group page to be titled "Use cases", with the list named "Use cases of DM-SHOP/use_case"; and a renamed kind to title the list with its own label.

title: An aggregate's domain events are listed apart, titled "Domain events", and left out of its Entities
when: Opens an aggregate's page.
then: Expects its Domain events list, one link per row with "Raised by" and "Reacted to by" counts, and the events left out of its Entities list; follows a row to the event and expects its Fields table and its Traceability's "Raised by" and "Reacted to by" groups with no relation codes; opens a reacting aggregate and expects "Reacts to".

title: plural() makes a kind label plural as English does, and counts with the singular for one
when: Pluralizes kind labels, and counts one and four of a kind.
then: Expects "UC requirements", "Policies" and the like, "1 domain" and "4 domains".

title: A refused change keeps the form open with what was entered and changes nothing on the page
when: Saves a change the store refuses.
then: Expects the form still open with what was entered, every reason at its top and beside the input its command came from, and the page unchanged.

title: Flow steps written out of order show in step order
when: Opens a flow with three steps written out of order.
then: Expects the Steps table with its four columns (Step, What happens, Uses, Carries out), rows in step order, and each cell linking the IDs.

title: Steps are ordered by their position as a number, then by ID
then: Expects `stepsOf` to order steps 2 then 10, and two steps of one position by ID.

title: In the graph a flow's steps sit in its neighborhood, joined to it directly
then: Expects a flow's three steps in its neighborhood, joined to it directly, all in the column after it.

title: In the map each step sits under its flow, or under a flow steps group under it
then: Expects a flow with six steps and nothing else to reach them directly, and one that also has an interaction requirement to reach them through a "Flow steps (6)" group in the next column, its steps framed at depth 2, and in the map each step under the group and the group under the flow.

title: The record page shows the ID, kind, title, text fields as Markdown, parent and children
when: Opens a use case.
then: Checks in the wiki card its ID, its kind badge in its stage's color, its goal rendered as Markdown and its child requirements, and its data file and parent link; then checks that Markdown in a text field is rendered.

title: The record page shows links out and in, grouped and named by their labels, each clickable
when: Opens a requirement.
then: Checks its incoming links grouped under their reverse labels (Carried out in, Designed by, Proved by), follows the satisfying component's link, and checks that component's outgoing links under their forward labels (Implements, Satisfies).

title: A record's text is sanitized before it is shown
when: Renders a text field holding a script, an image with an onerror handler and a javascript: link, and Markdown holding an iframe and an onclick.
then: Checks that none of them reaches the page or runs.

title: The record page lists every problem about the record
then: Checks that a test with a missing file shows its error and badge, and that a record with no problems says so.

title: A click on a row opens its record, and a click on its chevron or second link does what that control does
then: On a domain page, a click on a row's padding reaches its stretched row link and opens the record. jsdom has no layout, so the test sends the click where the browser does: to the topmost element at that point, which is the link's `::after`, that is the link itself; the stylesheet rules that make this so are proved by `LA-PAT-APP-UX-R05-T01`. The link is a real `href`, so Cmd/Ctrl-click is left to the browser and opens a new tab. A click on a row's fold chevron opens the row and stays on the page; a click on a second link in the row, a pattern's "followed by" use case, opens that use case instead. Right and Left arrow keys still open and close a tree row.

title: Every record ID named in the text becomes a link to its record, with its title on hover
when: Renders a text field.
then: Expects every occurrence of each named record ID linked to its record page with its title on hover.

title: A code span holding one lone record ID becomes a link, keeping its code style
then: Expects no links for IDs in code blocks, code spans with other text, links or longer IDs, a link around a code span holding one lone ID, and HTML left unchanged when there is nothing to link.

title: A text field links the records of the space it names, never the record itself
then: Expects a text field's links to be the records of the space it names, without the record's own ID, and an ID that is no record left as plain text.

title: On a record page the records a text field names are links that move within the app
when: Opens a record page.
then: Expects the named records as links, an unknown ID as plain text, code left plain, and a click that moves to the record.

title: A domain overview links the records its text names, and an ID inside a longer one only as the longer
then: Expects only the named ID linked beside a longer ID, no such link in the graph, and a domain overview that links the records its text names.

title: An ID-shaped token that names no record stays plain text
then: Expects a text field's links to be the records of the space it names, without the record's own ID, and an ID that is no record left as plain text.

title: On a record page an unknown ID stays plain text
when: Opens a record page.
then: Expects the named records as links, an unknown ID as plain text, code left plain, and a click that moves to the record.

title: Lists on group pages stay at ten rows
when: Gives a use case 13 requirements.
then: Expects a search box on the group page's members.

title: A domain page opens one level deep, and Expand all opens the rest
when: On a domain page.
then: Expects use cases and aggregates folded with their counts, opens and closes a row by button and by the arrow keys (moving into it and back to its parent), uses Expand all, and expects open rows still open after visiting another page.

title: A product page lists its domains but none of their records
when: Opens a domain's page.
then: Expects its records listed in their folders with their children folded, a record page whose wiki lists its children, and a product page that lists its domains but none of their records.

title: Requirements, pattern rules and standard rules read under their group headings, the ungrouped first
when: Opens a use case with one ungrouped requirement and three in two groups (one written in another case).
then: Expects the Children section and the requirement table to show the ungrouped one first and each group under its heading, a pattern page to group its rules the same way, and a standard's rule table to head its group's rows.

title: A flow page shows its steps in order as a table
when: Opens a flow with three steps written out of order.
then: Expects the Steps table with its four columns (Step, What happens, Uses, Carries out), rows in step order, and each cell linking the IDs.

title: Each step's description and the titles of what it uses and fulfills are folded under its row
then: Expects a step's description hidden until its row is unfolded, then rendered with the titles and kinds of what it fulfills; Expand all and Collapse all open and close every row.

title: A step row carries its problems, and a flow without steps has no table
then: Expects a warning badge on a step's row, and no Steps section on a flow without steps.

title: A flow with several paths shows a table per path, the main path first
when: Gives a flow steps on the main path (no path), an api path and a refused path written in mixed case.
then: Expects three tables headed Main path, Api path and Refused path, each in its own step order.

title: A command's page lists the endpoint that exposes it, with its method and route, and an endpoint's page its API requirements with their count
when: Renders a command's page and its endpoint's page.
then: Expects the endpoint among the command's children with POST and its route, and the endpoint's API requirements section with its count and the requirement's row.

title: An integration's page lists the flow steps that exchange with it, with their count, and names its outside system
when: Renders an integration's page.
then: Expects an Exchanged with by section with its count and the step's row, and the outside system in the page's details.

title: Edit opens a form in place of the page's content, and Save shows the record changed
when: Opens a requirement's page, chooses Edit, changes its statement and group, and saves.
then: Expects a form of typed inputs in place of the page's content, one write with only the changed columns, and the page showing the record changed.

title: Changes only what changed: the columns set or cleared, a move, links taken and added, and a part table written again
when: Turns an edited draft into commands.
then: Expects one write holding only a set of the changed columns, a move when the parent changed, the links taken and added, and the part rows written again.

title: Edit's form gives each column an input of its type and writes only the changed ones
when: Opens a requirement's page, chooses Edit, changes its statement and group, and saves.
then: Expects a form of typed inputs in place of the page's content, one write with only the changed columns, and the page showing the record changed.

title: Gives every column but the ID and the parent columns a typed input, in the table's order
when: Builds the form fields of several kinds from a schema description.
then: Expects one input per column in the table's order, typed by the column: a select for an enum, a number for a whole number, a check for true or false, a date, a list, with required columns marked.

title: Offers as parents and link targets only records of the allowed kinds in the same product
when: Asks for a record's parent choices and the targets of the links its kind may start.
then: Expects only records of the allowed kinds, in the record's product, never the record's own subtree as a parent.

title: Adds a child from its parent's page with a suggested ID, and opens it
when: On a use case's page chooses Add requirement, fills the form and saves.
then: Expects an empty form with the parent set and the next free ID suggested, one write that adds the record, and the new record's page opened.

title: Add a child from its parent's page
when: In Chromium, over a copy of a product, adds a child from its parent's page.
then: Expects the new record written and opened, and nothing on the page jumping.

title: Suggests the next free number in the kind's convention, and fills a new record's parent columns
when: Asks for an ID for a new record under several parents.
then: Expects the next free number in the kind's ID convention, or the start of a named ID.

title: Asks first, naming what still references the record, and shows the store's refusal inline
when: Chooses Remove on a record that others reference, and confirms.
then: Expects a question that lists the children and links that name it before anything is written, and the store's refusal shown inline after the write.

title: Remove on a referenced record asks first, naming what references it, and the record is kept
when: In Chromium, chooses Remove on a record others reference, and confirms.
then: Expects the question naming what references it, the store's refusal shown inline, and the record kept.

title: Names what still references the record, and what goes with it, before a removal
when: Asks what a removal of a referenced record would meet.
then: Expects its children and the links into it listed as what refuses the removal, and its parts and own links as what goes with it.

title: The store's refusal shows at the top of the form and beside the input it came from
when: Saves a change the store refuses.
then: Expects the form still open with what was entered, every reason at its top and beside the input its command came from, and the page unchanged.

title: Removing a referenced record shows the store's refusal inline
when: In Chromium, chooses Remove on a record others reference, and confirms.
then: Expects the question naming what references it, the store's refusal shown inline, and the record kept.

title: Edit a record with the keyboard, and focus comes back to its actions
when: In Chromium, opens a record, reaches Edit by Tab, changes a field and saves with the keyboard alone, with axe-core run on the form.
then: Expects focus on the form's first input, the save done from the keyboard, focus back on the record's actions, and no axe-core finding at WCAG 2.2 AA.

title: The record page shows a test's state, and says a planned test is not proof
when: Opens a planned, a manual and an automated test.
then: Expects a State row with each state, the raw `state` field not repeated, and a note on the planned test only.

title: The record content takes a record ID and sends the links it follows to its host
when: Renders the record content on its own with an `onNavigate` spy.
then: Expects clicks on links in the text, aside and header to call it with the address while the browser address stays put, the container class that lets it fold at half width, and a message for an unknown ID.

title: A list of up to 10 items is plain; a longer one scrolls inside, with search, a count and a no-match message
when: Renders the long list with 10 and with 12 items.
then: Expects no search box at 10; at 12, a focusable scrolling region, a search box reached by Tab that filters by ID and by title, a count that follows it, a message when nothing matches, and Escape clearing the search.

title: Every list in the spec pages stays at 10 rows and can be searched
when: Serves a product with 12 domains, 12 use cases, 12 requirements under one use case and 12 problems.
then: Expects a search box on the menu's domain list, the domain page's use case group and nested requirements, its gaps and problems, a record's children and links in, and a group on the checks page.

title: A pattern page shows its settings, rules and followers
when: Opens a pattern page.
then: Expects the settings table with dependent rules, the rules once, and each following domain with its use cases and their setting values.

title: A pattern page shows each domain's status per rule
then: Expects each following domain's table to give each rule's status in that domain.

title: A pattern rule page lists the domains that owe it
when: Opens a pattern rule page.
then: Expects both following domains; then a pattern nobody follows, which says so.

title: An obligation lists Designed by, Built by and Proved by as its chain holds them, each build record marked built or not
when: Opens a UC requirement's and an invariant's content.
then: Expects their Traceability groups in order (Designed by, Built by, Proved by) holding the engine's chain, only the build records marked built or not built, kind tags only in the list that mixes kinds, and no gap callout for a requirement that is designed, built and proved.

title: Gap callouts agree with coverage, link to their check, and a pattern rule has one line per domain
then: Expects "Not proved yet" and "Not designed yet" callouts linked to the unproved and unsatisfied check pages, a pattern rule judged in each domain owing it (not built and only planned in one, designed, built and proved in the other, and a rule not applicable in a domain left out there), and every coverage gap of every domain matched by a callout.

title: An obligation's Traceability shows what designs it and what proves it, and names a gap in a callout
when: Opens obligations of each kind, proved and not.
then: Expects what designs and proves each, and a callout for each gap.

title: A use case shows a requirement table, then what carries it out, follows and applies
then: Expects a use case's table with the columns Requirement, Designed, Built and Proved, one row per requirement in ID order, cells linking the designing component and the proving test or flagging "not proved", then the groups Carried out by flow and Applies, the applied rule showing its own coverage mark.

title: A component shows Satisfies and Proved through; a test shows Proves and its file with its state
then: Expects a component's groups Satisfies, Proved through (the test proving what it designs) and Implements, and a test's Proves and Run by, the file shown with the test's state and flagged missing with a link to the test-file-missing check.

title: An aggregate's page lists its domain events titled "Domain events", each row a whole link saying what raises it and how many react; an event's page shows its Fields table, "Raised by" and "Reacted to by", and a reacting record shows "Reacts to"
when: Opens an aggregate's page.
then: Expects its Domain events list, one link per row with "Raised by" and "Reacted to by" counts, and the events left out of its Entities list; follows a row to the event and expects its Fields table and its Traceability's "Raised by" and "Reacted to by" groups with no relation codes; opens a reacting aggregate and expects "Reacts to".

title: The wiki card's kind, each problem code and each column label link to their format pages
when: Opens a record page, a domain page, the Checks panel and a group page.
then: Expects the Kind row and a column label to link to the kind's page and its column, each problem code to its check's page, and a group's kind to its page.

title: The product lists its standards under Shared, beside its patterns
when: Opens the product.
then: Expects one Shared folder counting the pattern, the standard and its rule's test, listing the pattern then the standard, the test under the test plan, and no standard among the product's groups.

title: A standard's page lists its rules with what meets each one and the tests that prove it
when: Opens a standard.
then: Expects its Rules table with the columns Rule, Met by and Proved by, a rule's row linking the handler that meets it and its standard rule test, and Nothing yet for a rule no test proves.

title: A standard rule's Traceability shows what meets it and its tests, and what meets it shows Meets
when: Opens a standard rule.
then: Expects Met by in its Traceability with the handler and Proved by with its standard rule test; then opens the handler and expects the rule under Meets.

title: The format reference has a page for each standard kind, from the schema
when: Opens the standard rule's kind page.
then: Expects its folder, Shared, its parent kind, standard, Met by among its links in, from a component, and its description.

title: In the desktop app a record page offers its file actions and a native menu, and in a browser none
when: Opens a record in a browser, then in the desktop app.
then: Expects no record actions in a browser; in the desktop app, Reveal in Finder, Open in editor and Copy ID for the record's data file; a right-click on the page title or a record link asking for the native menu, and elsewhere the page's own; and records found under nodes, links and titles.

title: A capability shows the outcomes it serves; a test data set shows its setup and the tests that start from it; a test shows its size and markers
then: Expects Serves on the capability, the data set's Environment, Starting records, Prepare and Reset with its tests and no run by, and a test's Size volume and Markers smoke, a plain test being small with none.

title: An outcome shows the tests that measure it and how it is measured outside the code; a test shows the outcomes it measures
then: Expects Measured by with the test on the first outcome, its measure outside the code on the second, and Measures with the outcome on the test.

title: A use case lists its flows by interface, and a flow names its interface
An interface lists its flows by capability and the use cases with no flow through it
Under reduced motion focusing frames the new focus at once
when: Asks for reduced motion, clicks a requirement in its use case's graph.
then: Expects one camera move, straight to the framed view.

title: By touch, a node opens only on a second tap or a tap on its card
when: On a touch screen, taps a graph node on the canvas.
then: Expects the address unchanged, the node drawn as selected and its box in the keyboard layer outlined, and a card naming it; a tap on the canvas away from every box lets go; the card is one button named for opening the node, beside the let go button, and a tap on it opens the node. `isTap` reads a mouse as a click and a finger or a pen as a tap.

title: Stability: an open pane is not drawn anew, and a canvas that opens appears already fitted
when: Opens and closes the Graph and ERD panes (Ctrl+2, Ctrl+4, Ctrl+1), full screen (Ctrl+3, Escape).
then: Expects the nav to stay, open panes not to be drawn anew, and a canvas to appear already fitted.

title: A domain event is a flag in its stage's colors
then: Expects the event's shape a flag in the Domain model stage.

title: A domain's hexagon points grow with its box up to a cap, and tree lines meet their tips
then: Checks the chamfer's growth and cap, a line out of a domain starting at the point's tip at its middle and on its slanted side above it, a line into a domain meeting the tip; and on a product's graph every domain node, and only domains, carrying the hexagon's class and its polygon outline, and the product its rounded box.

title: Stability: a domain is drawn as a hexagon, its outline the polygon in every state
when: Opens the product's graph.
then: Expects the domain drawn as its hexagon, its outline a six-cornered polygon; hovered, the same polygon in the hover state; focused, still the polygon, drawn as the focus; and the product drawn as a rounded box, not a polygon.

title: Every kind is drawn in its own shape, a group as a folder and an added kind as a plain box
then: Expects every kind of the meta-model to have the shape and mark of the rule's table, a group a folder and an unknown kind a plain box, every shape and mark used and named in the key; on a leaf and on boxes grown with their level, a label as tall and wide as its padding and room allow, and its badge at the top right, inside every shape's outline; and each shape's outline, notch and room as the page draws them.

title: Stability: in the Tree view every label line and badge lands inside its own box's shape
when: Opens a domain's graph in the Tree view at each depth, and for every drawn box big enough to read hit-tests, with the canvas's own hit test, the corners of each label line (at its drawn width) and each badge, expecting each to land on its own box, inside its polygon or rounded outline; then in the Nested view.
then: Expects every record box to be drawn with its kind's shape mark and no outline of its own.

title: The pointer finds the deepest box under it from the map's outlines
then: Expects a point inside a polygon found and one outside not; a rounded box's corner outside its curve not its box; in each layout the middle of every box's label to find that box, not its parent drawn under it; nothing far outside the map; and a hexagon's cut corner outside the domain.

title: Only boxes on screen are drawn, placed relative to the camera's center
then: Expects a box on screen drawn and a box wholly past an edge culled, a far box coming into view when the camera zooms out about the same center, and a tiny box deep in a very large map, at a very deep zoom, placed as exactly as one near the origin.

title: Stability: the camera moves at every focus, Back and Forward
when: Focuses a domain, a stage, a folder, a capability and a use case by clicking, then goes Back twice and Forward once.
then: Expects the camera different at each step.

title: Stability: zooming the camera draws a label at its map size times the zoom
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph, focuses its Design stage and zooms in.
then: Expects the title's font size in map units and its lines unchanged, and its size on screen to change by the camera's zoom alone.

title: Depth counts levels of the tree below the focus, stages and folders included, with the parent kept
when: Frames a requirement at depths 1 to 3 (the same picture: it has nothing below it), the Use cases stage at each depth (its capabilities, their use cases, their requirements), the Domain model stage at depth 1 (its folders), and an aggregate.
then: Expects the parent kept, each node's distance and the node it was reached from, only parent lines, and no sibling or link.

title: Clicking a neighbor frames it, and the address, the header strip and the wiki card follow
when: Renders a flow step's page on the Graph stage in jsdom and clicks its flow.
then: Expects the address `/P-D-UC01-FL01?stage=graph`, the header strip's title and the graph's center on it, its use case drawn and no visited trail; then goes back and expects the flow step again.

title: At depth 1 the graph frames the tree around the focus: its parent or folder at the left edge, its children or their folders, and no other links
when: Frames a capability in its stage, a domain, an aggregate with two kinds of children and a requirement at depth 1.
then: Expects the parent, the children or their groups, no siblings, and only parent lines.

title: The graph opens at depth 1, framing the parent and the children, and depth 2 and 3 frame more levels below; only parent lines are drawn
when: Opens the Use cases stage's graph.
then: Expects the depth buttons 1 to 3 with 1 pressed and no links, then depth 2 framing more records with a new summary; then a flow step's graph drawing only parent lines, and no Links button.

title: Depth counts levels below a domain and a use case, as a file explorer does
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 to 3.
then: Expects its stages, then their folders, then what is in them, one level more each time; and a use case in a capability, its capability the only node above it at every depth.

title: Stability: at depth 2 on a domain, the domain, its stages and their folders are framed in the canvas, each showing its full title wrapped on whole words
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects, in the drawn scene, the domain, every stage and at least half the folders wholly in the canvas, and every framed box (the domain, its product at the left edge, its stages and their folders) labeled with its whole title, each of its lines fitting as drawn and every line but the last ending after a space or a hyphen.

title: Clicking a node re-centers the graph and changes the address, Back walks back, and no visited trail is drawn
when: Renders a flow step's page on the Graph stage in jsdom and clicks a neighbor.
then: Expects the address `/P-V01?stage=graph`, the header strip's title and the graph's center on it, its neighbors drawn and no visited trail; then goes back and expects the flow step again.

title: Nodes and lines show stage, errors and gaps, with a key
then: Expects each node drawn in its stage's colors, an error badge on a test with an error, a gap badge on a rule with a gap, the parent lines, and the key.

title: On a product's graph only domain nodes carry the hexagon's class, and the product a rounded box
then: Checks the chamfer's growth and cap, a line out of a domain starting at the point's tip at its middle and on its slanted side above it, a line into a domain meeting the tip; and on a product's graph every domain node, and only domains, carrying the hexagon's class and its polygon outline, and the product its rounded box.

title: Stability: a domain keeps its hexagon when hovered and focused, and the product is a rounded box
when: Opens the product's graph.
then: Expects the domain drawn as its hexagon, its outline a six-cornered polygon; hovered, the same polygon in the hover state; focused, still the polygon, drawn as the focus; and the product drawn as a rounded box, not a polygon.

title: Each shape keeps its label and badge inside its outline, and the key names every shape and mark
then: Expects every kind of the meta-model to have the shape and mark of the rule's table, a group a folder and an unknown kind a plain box, every shape and mark used and named in the key; on a leaf and on boxes grown with their level, a label as tall and wide as its padding and room allow, and its badge at the top right, inside every shape's outline; and each shape's outline, notch and room as the page draws them.

title: Stability: in the Nested view every record box shows its kind's shape mark and no outline
when: Opens a domain's graph in the Tree view at each depth, and for every drawn box big enough to read hit-tests, with the canvas's own hit test, the corners of each label line (at its drawn width) and each badge, expecting each to land on its own box, inside its polygon or rounded outline; then in the Nested view.
then: Expects every record box to be drawn with its kind's shape mark and no outline of its own.

title: Every box look, badge and line style the Graph stage can draw is in its key, with what it means
when: Opens the graph's Key popover from the Graph stage's toolbar and reads every look, badge, shape and line style the graph can draw.
then: Expects each in the key with words saying what it means.

title: Filters hide kinds and paths through them, never the focus
when: Hides use cases, entities, aggregates and the focus's own kind.
then: Expects the hidden records to go, nothing to be reached through them, a folder gone with its kind while a stage stays, and the focus to stay even when its own kind is hidden.

title: The arrow keys step through the tree from a focused box, Enter re-centers on the box with keyboard focus, and Escape clears the filters
when: Focuses the center box and presses Left, Right and Down; presses Up on the canvas, and Left with Alt held; focuses another box and presses Enter; hides a kind and presses Escape.
then: Expects each arrow to move the focus with keyboard focus following from a box and staying on the canvas, Alt+Left to do nothing, Enter to re-center on the focused box, and Escape to show the hidden kind again.

title: Stability: in every layout Tab, Enter and the Left arrow work the graph with a visible focus ring
when: Runs one table of the graph's features in each layout.
then: The Layout switch and its `v` command, a click to focus, Enter on a focused box, Tab through the drawn boxes with a visible focus ring, the plain Left arrow stepping out to the parent once the graph has focus, `.` framing the focus, depth 1 to 3, a hidden kind keeping its space, the minimap, the trail, Back and Forward, and the hover spotlight; in the Nested view, every drawn child inside its parent's box on screen and the view kept for the session across a reload; and in the Voronoi view, every drawn cell a polygon whose label's middle the pointer finds it at, inside its parent's box on screen.

title: Columns follow the parent/child tree
then: Expects a requirement's ancestors in columns 0 to 3, the domain's other children beside the use case whatever their kind, and every parent line running from one column to the next.

title: The graph reads left to right by column
then: Expects one x and one width per level of the map, levels left to right a gap apart, and ancestors to the left of a record.

title: Links never change the map or the framed picture: every box where it was without them
when: Adds two sibling entities that link to each other.
then: Expects every box of the map where it was without the links, and the picture framed around one of them unchanged, with only parent lines.

title: The page draws the map in columns with a solid parent/child spine, and draws no link between siblings
when: Opens a flow step's graph, then an aggregate's entities.
then: Expects the flow left of its step and a solid spine; then the three sibling entities that link to each other in one column, with no link drawn between them.

title: Siblings of mixed kinds share a column
then: Expects a component's sibling groups in one column and their members of several kinds in the next, every node with the same parent in one column, and a domain's open groups' members of eight kinds at one x position on the canvas.

title: Ancestors sit to the left of the focus and descendants to its right
then: Expects a use case's product, domain and group in columns 0 to 2, the use case in column 3 and its requirement in column 4, and the same order on the canvas.

title: Focusing a child glides the camera on the shared motion, and no box moves or changes size
when: Opens a use case's graph, framed at once, clicks its requirement.
then: Expects the camera to glide there over several frames and end framing it, every box drawn before and after at the same place and size, and Back gliding back.

title: Focusing under reduced motion moves the camera once, never the map
when: Asks for reduced motion, clicks a requirement in its use case's graph.
then: Expects one camera move, straight to the framed view.

title: Stability: focusing anything moves the camera only, and no box changes its place or size
when: Focuses a domain, a stage, a folder, a capability and a use case by clicking, then goes Back twice and Forward once.
then: Expects each step stable, the camera different at each, and every box seen to keep the same place and size in the map throughout.

title: Hovering or focusing a box spotlights it, its lines and the boxes it joins, and leaving restores the picture
when: Opens a flow and focuses its first step.
then: Expects the step, the flow and the line between them lit, the flow's other step and its line dimmed, and blurring it to restore the picture.

title: Stability: in every layout hovering spotlights a node
when: Runs one table of the graph's features in each view.
