then: The Layout switch and its `v` command, a click to focus, Enter on a focused box, Tab through the drawn boxes with a visible focus ring, the plain Left arrow stepping out to the parent once the graph has focus, `.` framing the focus, depth 1 to 3, a hidden kind keeping its space, the minimap, the trail, Back and Forward, and the hover spotlight; in the Nested view, every drawn child inside its parent's box on screen and the view kept for the session across a reload; and in the Voronoi view, every drawn cell a polygon whose label's middle the pointer finds it at, inside its parent's box on screen.

title: In the Tree view the plain arrow keys step through the tree from the page, and buttons step too, naming their keys
when: Reads the step targets of a use case, a folder and the product, then shows the graph and presses the arrow keys on its canvas and on the page, with Alt held on the page, and clicks the step buttons.
then: Expects Right to step in to the first child, Left out to the parent and Up to the previous sibling, each moving the graph's focus; an only child's Up and Down to go on to a node at the same depth under another parent; the step buttons naming ArrowLeft and ArrowDown, and Out and In Shift+ArrowUp and Shift+ArrowDown, in aria-keyshortcuts; and nothing to step from Alt+Down.

title: Each arrow takes its view's step: in Tree, Left out, Right in, Up and Down across; in Nested and Voronoi, Up out, Down in, Left and Right across; across goes on past the first sibling
given: A stage in the Graph stage, which has a parent, a first child and a sibling either side, drawn in the Tree, Nested and Voronoi views in turn.
when: In each view, reads the step buttons, presses each of the four arrows on the canvas and goes Back after each, steps previous from the first stage twice and then next, then opens the shortcuts sheet.
then: Expects each arrow to step where the view's mapping says, previous from the first sibling to go on to the previous parent's last child at that level and next to come back, the step buttons Left, Right, Up, Down, Out and In in the same order in every view, each named by the step its arrow takes in that view and showing its arrow and letter, with its keys in aria-keyshortcuts, and the sheet's rows listing each move's arrow and letter, Out and In with Shift.

title: Filters have a Minimap switch, off by default and kept while walking, and the minimap is an overview of the whole map
when: Opens Filters.
then: Expects a Minimap switch, off, no context ring switch, and no relation filters or preset; switches the minimap on and expects an overview of the map's upper levels, the focus solid and the view outlined, still there after walking on.

title: Stability: the Layout switch and v move between Tree, Nested and Voronoi, kept across a reload
when: Runs one table of the graph's features in each view.
then: The Layout switch and its `v` command, a click to focus, Enter on a focused box, Tab through the drawn boxes with a visible focus ring, the plain Left arrow stepping out to the parent once the graph has focus, `.` framing the focus, depth 1 to 3, a hidden kind keeping its space, the minimap, the trail, Back and Forward, and the hover spotlight; in the Nested view, every drawn child inside its parent's box on screen and the view kept for the session across a reload; and in the Voronoi view, every drawn cell a polygon whose label's middle the pointer finds it at, inside its parent's box on screen.

title: Depth shows only in the Tree layout
when: Opens a stage in the Tree layout.
then: Expects the Depth buttons shown. Switches to Nested and then Voronoi, and expects the Depth group to keep its slot but be hidden, aria-hidden and inert, so it is neither seen nor reached. Switches back to Tree and expects it again.

title: Stability: in the Voronoi view every drawn cell is a polygon inside its parent, found at its label
when: Runs one table of the graph's features in each view.
then: The Layout switch and its `v` command, a click to focus, Enter on a focused box, Tab through the drawn boxes with a visible focus ring, the plain Left arrow stepping out to the parent once the graph has focus, `.` framing the focus, depth 1 to 3, a hidden kind keeping its space, the minimap, the trail, Back and Forward, and the hover spotlight; in the Nested view, every drawn child inside its parent's box on screen and the view kept for the session across a reload; and in the Voronoi view, every drawn cell a polygon whose label's middle the pointer finds it at, inside its parent's box on screen.

title: In the Voronoi view the camera frames the focus cell, and the page draws each cell as its outline
when: Frames the product, a domain and a use case in the Voronoi map on a canvas of 1000 by 800.
then: Expects the focus's box centered, every drawn cell in view and at least 3 pixels across, a parent drawn before its children, the drawing within its budget and the focus drawn. On the page, with the Voronoi layout chosen, expects each cell drawn as its polygon with its label inside, the pointer finding the cell at its label's middle and not at a corner of its bounding box outside its outline, and a click on a child gliding the camera to frame its cell.

title: A record with several kinds of child has a labeled, counted group per kind
then: Checks which records are grouped (only those with more than one kind of child, however many of one kind), the groups' labels such as "Requirements (6)", their members, and that a group's ID is its parent and kind and names no record.

title: Every group is in the map with all its members beside it, and the spine runs record, group, record
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 and 2.
then: Expects its stages and folders as groups with their counts, the spine running through a group to its records, and every group in the map holding all its members right beside it and spanning them exactly.

title: A stage or folder is drawn as a folder group, and Enter on a stage goes to its address
when: Opens a domain's graph.
then: Expects the open questions' group drawn as a folder with no chevron and no button; clicks the group and expects its address, the group the center, and its name and count in its tooltip; goes back and presses Enter on a stage and expects its address.

title: Groups are drawn as folders, and the key has an entry for them
when: Renders a domain.
then: Expects error and gap marks on the groups with trouble beneath them, none on a clean group, an accessible label that says folded, and a key entry for groups.

title: The graph's tree is the nav's tree
then: Expects a domain's stages and folders in the nav's order and counts, Capabilities as one list, a capability's use cases as its children with its test in the Test plan, Interaction design split by kind, Technical specification's layers then components, the product's Shared folder before its domains, and every child's parent to be the node that lists it.

title: Filters hide groups with their kind
then: Expects no group for a hidden kind, a stage kept when one of its kinds is hidden, and the same graph every time.

title: A group shows its name and count, with no chevron; clicking a group, or Enter on it, goes to it
when: Opens a domain's graph.
then: Expects the open questions' group drawn as a folder with no chevron and no button; clicks the group and expects its address, the group the center, and its name and count in its tooltip; goes back and presses Enter on a stage and expects its address.

title: A group can be the focus: its parent and all its members are shown, and depth counts levels from it
when: Centers on the Aggregates folder.
then: Expects its stage and every member, the spine through it, the members' children and groups framed at depth 2 and their members at depth 3, nothing for a group that does not exist, an older kind group's address still working, and its `/<domain-id>/<stage>/<folder>` address both ways, the old `/graph/...` one leading there.

title: A group has its own address with its parent left and its members right, and Back works
when: Opens a domain on the Graph stage and clicks its Domain model stage's box.
then: Expects the stage's address and title, the stage framed with the domain to its left and its folders to its right, the header strip's breadcrumb naming the domain, follows its Aggregates folder and goes Back to the stage.

title: A stage or folder group page names the group by its own name, not by a kind
when: Opens a domain's Define stage page.
then: Expects its intro and its wiki page to say "Define", never "Defines".

title: A group carries a summary mark for problems and gaps beneath it
then: Expects the aggregates' group to carry the warnings and gaps of the rules beneath the aggregate, the tests' group to carry the test's error, and the use cases' group nothing.

title: A group carries error and gap marks when trouble lies beneath it, and none when clean
when: Renders a domain.
then: Expects error and gap marks on the groups with trouble beneath them, none on a clean group, an accessible label that says folded, and a key entry for groups.

title: Groups take their own column between the parent and its children
when: Lays out a group's neighborhood.
then: Expects the parent, the group, its members, a member's own group and its members from left to right, a member's group beside another member's ungrouped child, and every group one column after its parent and one before its members.

title: A group sits in its own column between its parent and its members
then: Expects a domain, its use case group, the use cases, a use case's requirement group and its opened members each one column further right, the group beside another use case's ungrouped requirement.

title: An aggregate's events sit under it in a Domain events group, and the graph draws no raises or hears link
then: Expects the aggregate's Domain events group with its count, the event under it, and only parent lines in the event's picture.

title: A parent spans its children stacked, an equal part each, from its top edge to its bottom edge, each child beside it, nothing overlapping
when: Builds the maps of three workspaces, two synthetic trees and a product with a busy part and a quiet one.
then: Expects every root the product box's height, every parent's children of one height, stacked from its top to its bottom a tenth of each one's part apart, each in the next level right of it, no two boxes in a level overlapping, the busy part and the quiet one the same height with the busy one's children smaller, and the tree the nav's.

title: Tall parents carry their height and text scale, every box its text scale as its box scale, and every parent line is level
when: Opens a domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects, in the drawn scene, the domain taller than its stages stacked with a text scale above 1, every drawn box's box scale its text scale, and every parent line drawn level.

title: Stability: at depth 2 on a domain, every framed box shows its full title wrapped on whole words
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects every framed box (the domain, its product at the left edge, its stages and their folders) labeled with its whole title, each of its lines fitting as drawn and every line but the last ending after a space or a hyphen.

title: Stability: no label is clipped, in light and dark, focused or not, at several zooms
when: In light and dark, on the Exploring domain and its Define stage at depths 1 to 3 and zoomed in twice.
then: Expects every drawn box in the canvas to fit each of its lines, read from the drawn scene: each line's width as the canvas measures it at its drawn font at most its placed width, and the line inside its box, with half a map unit and half a pixel to spare.

title: Stability: a label keeps its size in the map when the focus changes
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph, reads its Design stage's title font size in the drawn scene and its lines, then focuses the stage.
then: Expects the font size in map units and the lines unchanged, and the title's size on screen to change only with the camera's zoom.

title: Pattern rules sit under their pattern in the graph
then: Expects parent lines from the pattern to its rules and each rule one column to the pattern's right.

title: A flow step sits one column right of its flow, joined by the parent line
then: Expects a flow's three steps in its neighborhood, joined to it directly, all in the column after it.

title: A flow's steps hang under it directly, or through a group beside other kinds
then: Expects a flow with six steps and nothing else to reach them directly, and one that also has an interaction requirement to reach them through a "Flow steps (6)" group in the next column, its steps framed at depth 2, and in the map each step under the group and the group under the flow.

title: A domain reaches its technical records through Technical specification, then a folder per kind
then: Expects the domain's Technical specification stage, its kind folders, and a repository and a command handler under theirs.

title: A domain reaches its tests through Test plan, then a folder per test kind, as the nav does
then: Expects the domain's Test plan stage, each of its folders holding tests of its own kind, and a flow test under Flow tests.

title: The graph draws a standard as stacked boxes with a ruler in the product's Technical specification
then: Expects the standard under its product's Technical specification folder with its rules under it, drawn in the Technical specification stage's colors as stacked boxes and its rules as octagons, each with a ruler mark, and the key's stage, shape and ruler entries naming them.

title: In each layout, the arrows, a click, Enter, a tab and Back keep the layout, depth and minimap, in tabs open or new
given: A lasting tab on a flow drawn as it starts, and a lasting tab on its first step where the person set depth 2, the minimap on and the layout (Tree, Nested or Voronoi).
when: Steps out, in, next, previous, next and out, each by the arrow that takes that step in the layout (LA-V93-R19), into the open tabs and into pages no tab holds, clicks a box, presses Enter on one, activates a tab and goes Back.
then: Expects the toolbar to show the layout, depth and minimap the person set after every move, and the session to hold them; then v changes the layout.

title: Stability: in each layout, the arrows and clicks keep the layout, depth and minimap, into tabs open or new
given: In Chromium, a lasting tab on LA-EXP-UC03-FL01 drawn as it starts, and a lasting tab on its first step where the person set depth 2, the minimap on and the layout (Tree, Nested or Voronoi).
when: Steps out, in, next twice, previous twice and out, each by the arrow that takes that step in the layout (LA-V93-R19), across the open tabs and steps no tab holds, and clicks the boxes of steps open in a tab and not, stepping out by the layout's arrow after each.
then: Expects the graph's layout, the pressed layout and depth buttons and the minimap unchanged after every move.

title: The graph's settings last the session: the minimap comes back on reload
when: Turns the minimap on, then reloads the page.
then: Expects the minimap still on.

title: In each layout the focus and its subtree are drawn at full strength, its ancestors at their own, and every other box faded; the fade follows the focus
when: Opens a domain's graph in the Tree, Nested and Voronoi layouts, then clicks a faded box to focus it.
then: Expects the focus and every box under it at strength 1, its ancestors at the ancestors' strength in Nested and Voronoi and the fade's in Tree, every other box at the fade's, and after the click the new focus and its subtree at full strength and the old focus faded.

title: The map draws each domain as a region around its aggregates, and a reference to another domain's aggregate between regions
when: Builds the product's map, lays it out and opens the product on the ERD stage.
then: Expects one region per domain holding its aggregates, the reference to the other domain's aggregate running from region to region, each box inside its parent, and on the page each region labeled with its domain's name and nothing faded.

title: An aggregate's focus fades the aggregates it references, and its lines to them
when: Works out each box's strength for an aggregate's focus, then opens the aggregate.
then: Expects the aggregates it references faded, and on the page their boxes and the lines to them marked faded at the fade's strength.

title: A large region is laid out to about the map's shape, its layers wrapped or its parts packed, whichever comes nearer
when: Lays out a large domain's fifteen aggregates at their sizes with the references between them, wrapped and as the region pass does.
then: Expects the wrapped layout to stand taller than wide and the region to keep the nearer one, between 1.3 and 2.1 times as wide as tall.

title: The map draws each aggregate as a boundary around its entities with their fields, has one and has many lines with crow's feet, and a dashed reference from an entity to another aggregate's root
when: Builds the product's map and opens it.
then: Expects only domains, aggregates and entities, each aggregate a boundary around its entities with the root marked and each field's type, the has one and has many lines with their ends, one dashed reference line per entity and referenced aggregate ending at its root, each box laid out inside its parent; then on the page the boxes' names, the fields, no command, event or policy box, and the lines' tooltips.

title: An aggregate's focus keeps its boundary, entities, fields and lines at full strength, and fades the rest
when: Works out each box's strength and the scope's lines for an aggregate, then opens it.
then: Expects its boundary and entities at full strength, every other box, its domain's region among them, faded back, its scope's lines with their ends, lines from box edge to box edge and fanned apart; then on the page the root mark, the fields list, the aggregate picked out, another aggregate faded and a line to it faded.

title: An entity's focus keeps its aggregate at full strength, picks the entity out and frames it
when: Frames a child entity on the laid-out map, then opens it in the ERD stage.
then: Expects the camera to frame that entity's box, its aggregate at full strength, the entity alone picked out and named so, and the key naming the picked-out box.

title: Clicking a box goes to it, boxes show a hover state, and the toolbar's key lists only the boxes and lines drawn
when: Opens a domain on the ERD stage.
then: Expects the key, in the stage toolbar's Key popover, to list Domain, Aggregate boundary, Entity, Root entity, Picked out and Faded, then Has one, Has many and Reference by ID, clicks an aggregate's box and expects its page with the same stage, presses Enter on an entity's box and expects its page, and expects the hover ring, its speed and the domain model stage's tokens in the stylesheet.

title: Every box, badge and line an ERD draws is in the ERD stage's key, with what it means
when: Reads the key for a product, each domain, aggregate and entity on the model's map, and the ERD's styled marks.
then: Expects every mark drawn in the key with its meaning, and every styled mark one the test explains.

title: A domain's focus fades the other domains' regions, out of focus and out of the keyboard order, the fade easing on the shared motion
when: Works out each box's strength for a domain, reads the stylesheet, then opens the domain.
then: Expects only the other domain's region, aggregate and entity faded, the boxes' strength easing on the shared motion, and on the page the faded box hidden from assistive technology and out of the keyboard order while a box of the domain keeps its stop.

title: The frame fits what it frames inside the margin at any canvas size and inside the open space, never zoomed in past 1
when: Lays out the map and frames the whole map, an aggregate and an entity at three canvas sizes, then the whole map in an open space.
then: Expects every framed box inside the margin at a zoom of at most 1 at each size, and every box inside the open space a host's panels leave when framed in it.

title: A box whose center lies past an edge counts for that edge, and a chip pans half the canvas that way
when: Counts four box centers against a 1000 by 800 canvas, one seen through a zoomed and panned camera, and pans right and up.
then: Expects one past each edge, none for the box the moved camera brings inside, and each pan to move the camera half the canvas.

title: Any other record frames its nearest entity or aggregate in its domain, a Shared record and the product the whole map
when: Works out the ERD focus of a domain, an aggregate, an entity, a use case, a command, its handler, an event, a table, a group, a Shared value object and the product, frames each on the laid-out map, then opens a use case and an aggregate.
then: Expects a domain, aggregate or entity to pick out and frame its own box, any other record its nearest aggregate or entity (a table its entity) in its domain's scope, a Shared record and the product the whole map; the ERD button pressed and enabled on a use case, the domain's boxes in focus and the other domain's faded; and Ctrl+2 and Alt+G switching an aggregate between the ERD and Graph stages.

title: The map is laid out once: focusing two records moves no box and changes no size, and the layout is read again, never redone
when: Asks for the product's map and its layout twice, and for the layout of the same data loaded again, then opens a domain on the ERD stage and focuses an aggregate and then an entity by a click and by Enter.
then: Expects the same map and the same layout each time, a small map drawing every box, and every box's place and size on the page the same before and after each focus.

title: The product's ERD map is drawn and framed within its first-frame budget, and a focus after it lays nothing out
when: On the product's page, switches to the ERD stage, then clicks a domain's region.
then: Expects the map drawn and framed within the first-frame budget (ELK and the layout included), and the domain's focus, a camera move only, within the camera move budget.

title: Record, domain and product pages open on the Graph stage with their graph, and the nav has no Graph item
when: Opens a requirement, a domain and a product with no stage remembered, switches to the Trace stage and back.
then: Expects the Graph stage pressed, no Graph item in the nav, the focus drawn, and after switching back the address `?stage=graph` with the focus drawn again.

title: Every page opens its graph in its own Graph stage, and the open nav has no Graph item
then: Expects no Graph item in the open nav or the rail, the page's Graph stage, Ctrl+2 and the palette's Graph stage command.

title: The graph takes its focus and reports moves through onNavigate and what it draws through onCounts, without touching the address
when: Renders the graph view on its own away from its record's address, clicks a node, and renders it on the node's focus.
then: Expects the counts reported as records and links, the move reported through the callback, and the address unchanged throughout.

title: A record and a group each have one address, whatever the stage
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage and a group page at its own address.
then: Expects the Graph stage drawn with the address the bare ID, and the group page titled by its group.

title: An old address is no page: /records, /specs and /graph addresses say so, and the address stays as typed
when: Opens `/records/<id>`, `/records/<parent>/<kind>`, `/specs`, `/specs/<product>/<domain>`, `/graph` and `/graph/<id>`.
then: Expects each to read as a missing page, to say there is no such page, and to keep its address. Then opens a record with the old `?view=trace` and expects the Graph stage, as `view` names no stage.

title: The stage switch shows one stage at a time, named in the link and remembered, the Graph by default
when: Opens a use case with no stage, switches to the ERD, then opens another record.
then: Expects the Graph stage pressed and drawn with no pane, Split, Open beside or full screen; the ERD named as `?stage=erd`, pressed, the only stage drawn and remembered; the other record opening on the ERD; and the stage switch once, in the page bar.

title: Switching the stage by keyboard keeps focus, and the switch shows its keys and a focus ring
when: Focuses the graph's depth button on the Graph stage and presses Ctrl+2.
then: Expects the ERD stage drawn with focus on its pressed button, the Graph button's tooltip and `aria-keyshortcuts` naming Alt+G and Ctrl+1 off a Mac, and the shared focus ring and on look in the stylesheet.

title: Graph, ERD and Trace are pressed buttons of the stage switch, one pressed, its stage the one drawn
when: Opens a use case on the Trace stage.
then: Expects the Stage group's buttons Graph, ERD and Trace with Trace alone pressed, the Trace stage drawn and neither other stage.

title: The open space is measured from the panels' rectangles and written on the stage for its tools
when: Works out the open space a nav, a wiki card, a tab panel and a collapsed panel leave on a 1440 by 900 stage, and the frame a top toolbar leaves; then opens a use case on the Graph stage.
then: Expects the insets past each side's innermost panel plus the gap, nothing for a collapsed panel, the frame less the toolbar; on the page `--open-*` and `--frame-*` set on the stage with its tools at the top of the open space, in a room from the nav to the chat, centered on the whole stage while they fit and inside the room when wider, the tools' foot set on the stage's parent for the wiki card, and the Trace stage padding its content into the frame.

title: The graph frames its focus between the panels its host reports, and moves back when they go
when: Draws the graph 1200 by 800, then reports panels over the left 500 px, the right 300 px and the top 60 px, then none.
then: Expects the focus's box drawn inside the open space between them, and the camera to move again once the panels are gone.

title: The measure follows the stage the page makes anew when it changes between the phone and the wide layout
when: Opens a use case on the ERD stage, then narrows the screen to the phone layout and widens it again.
then: Expects the new stage to be another element, with `--open-left` set on it at once, so its tools sit inside the open space.

title: In the browser, at 1024 to 1920 px with the nav and the card open, the toolbar keeps its walk, Frame and the Graph's layouts and filters in its row, inside the open space
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage with the nav and the wiki card open, and sets the window 1024, 1280, 1440, 1600 and 1920 px wide.
then: Expects at each width the toolbar's row to fit, the toolbar inside the open space clear of the nav, the steps Left, Right, Up, Down, Out and In, Frame, the layouts and the filters in the row, never the phone's form, and the Changes controls in More whenever they are not in the row.

title: The stage, the header strip and the wiki card follow one focus, Back moves them all, and graph settings survive
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage at depth 2, follows a requirement's link in the wiki card, clicks its sibling on the stage, goes Back, and switches stage and back.
then: Expects the graph re-centered on the requirement, the card on the sibling after the click, the header strip and card back on the requirement after Back, and depth 2 kept across pages and stage switches.

title: A group page shows its parent, kind and members with their marks
when: Opens a group of domain rules.
then: Expects the parent link, the kind's description, and each member with its gap marks and problem badge.

title: Product and domain pages have the same three stages, their graph centered on the product or domain
when: Opens a product and a domain on the Graph stage.
then: Expects the overview's headings in the wiki card, the Stage group holding Graph, ERD and Trace, and the graph centered on the product or domain.

title: A product and a domain open at their IDs with their text in the wiki card
when: Opens a product and a domain at their IDs.
then: Expects its text in the wiki card, the parent, data file, links out, links in and problems in the wiki card, and no link to a second overview page.

title: The header strip names the focus in one line: its breadcrumb, kind, linked ID and title, whole in its tooltip, and the stage's counts
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage and reads the stylesheet.
then: Expects the page's h1 in the header strip with the breadcrumb, the kind badge and the ID linking to the use case, its whole title and ID as the tooltip, the graph's records and links as the counts, and the strip one fixed-height line whose title is cut with an ellipsis.

title: A plain open replaces the one preview tab in place, a page open in a tab activates it, and keeping makes a tab lasting
when: Opens pages in an empty tab set.
then: Expects each plain open to replace the preview tab where it sits, keeping its key, with its state made from the tab that was active; a kept tab to stay when the next page opens beside it; a page already open to activate its tab; a kept open to add a lasting tab after the active one; and never two previews or two tabs for one page.

title: A plain open replaces the italic preview tab, and a page already open activates its tab
when: Opens a record.
then: Expects one preview tab with its ID in mono, labeling the tab panel; follows a wiki link and expects the preview replaced; double-clicks it to keep it and expects the next page in a new preview beside it, a group's tab with its label and no ID; follows a link to the kept page and expects its tab active, no second tab; clicks a tab and expects the address to follow; closes it, goes Back and expects it reopened as the preview.

title: A page opened shows in a tab: a link to an open page activates it, and Back reopens a closed page as the preview
when: Opens a record, follows links, keeps a tab, opens a group, and closes it.
then: Expects one preview tab replaced in place, a group's tab with its label and no ID, a link to a kept page activating its tab, and Back reopening a closed page as the preview.

title: Double-clicking the preview tab keeps it, and the next page opens in a new preview beside it
when: Opens a record.
then: Expects one preview tab with its ID in mono, labeling the tab panel; follows a wiki link and expects the preview replaced; double-clicks it to keep it and expects the next page in a new preview beside it, a group's tab with its label and no ID; follows a link to the kept page and expects its tab active, no second tab; clicks a tab and expects the address to follow; closes it, goes Back and expects it reopened as the preview.

title: Alt+K then Enter keeps the preview tab, off a Mac
then: Expects the four tab commands in the keymap; keeps the preview with Alt+K then Enter (off a Mac); cycles with Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab; expects only the active tab in the Tab order, the arrow key to move focus, Enter to activate and Delete to close the focused tab, with focus left on the tab now active. Expects the active tab's close button to carry the close command's keys.

title: Switching a preview tab's stage keeps it open
when: Opens a use case in the preview tab and switches it to the ERD stage.
then: Expects the tab kept and the address `?stage=erd`.

title: Closing the active tab activates its right neighbor, or else the left; closing the last leaves it as a preview; cycling wraps
when: Cycles three lasting tabs both ways past each end, closes the active first tab.
then: Expects its right neighbor active, closes an inactive tab and expects the active one kept, closes the rightmost and expects its left neighbor, and closes the last and expects it still open, as the preview. Unknown keys change nothing.

title: Closing by button, middle-click or Alt+Shift+W activates the right neighbor or else the left, and the last tab stays as the preview
when: Keeps three tabs, activates the middle one and closes it with Alt+Shift+W, expecting the right neighbor and its address; middle-clicks the rightmost.
then: Expects the left neighbor; closes the last and expects it still open, as the preview.

title: Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycle the tabs, and on the focused strip the arrow keys move and Delete closes
then: Expects the four tab commands in the keymap; keeps the preview with Alt+K then Enter (off a Mac); cycles with Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab; expects only the active tab in the Tab order, the arrow key to move focus, Enter to activate and Delete to close the focused tab, with focus left on the tab now active. Expects the active tab's close button to carry the close command's keys.

title: The address follows the active tab, clicked or cycled
when: Keeps a tab, opens another, clicks the first, then presses Ctrl+Tab.
then: Expects the address to name the active tab's page each time.

title: Each tab keeps its own stage and wiki card scroll, and the graph's settings are the session's, whatever the tab
when: On a kept tab sets depth 2, scrolls the wiki card, switches to the ERD, then opens another page and works there, and returns to the first tab.
then: Expects the new page to start on the ERD with its card at the top and the depth the session's; the first tab back on its own stage and card scroll; and the graph drawn at the session's depth in every tab.

title: Each space keeps its own tabs, and switching spaces swaps the tab set
when: Opens two tabs in one product's space, moves to another product's page.
then: Expects only its tab, then switches back by the rail and expects the first space's two tabs again.

title: Tabs and space pages saved at anything but a page's address are dropped, not converted
when: Saves a tab set with two tabs at bare IDs and two under `/records` and `/specs`, and a space's last page under `/specs`, opens the app.
then: Expects only the two tabs at bare IDs, written back that way, and the space's rail link at its product.

title: Reloading brings back each tab's stage
when: Opens a use case on the Trace stage and a view on the ERD stage, each kept, activates the first, and reloads the app at its address.
then: Expects the Trace stage on the first tab after the reload, and the second tab, activated, back on `?stage=erd`.

title: Each tab shows its record's ID in mono and its title, and a group's tab its label alone
when: Opens a record.
then: Expects one preview tab with its ID in mono, labeling the tab panel; follows a wiki link and expects the preview replaced; double-clicks it to keep it and expects the next page in a new preview beside it, a group's tab with its label and no ID; follows a link to the kept page and expects its tab active, no second tab; clicks a tab and expects the address to follow; closes it, goes Back and expects it reopened as the preview.

title: View › Tabs owns Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab and sends every tab command by ID
then: Checks About Lathe and Settings… (Cmd+,) in the app menu on macOS and in File and Help elsewhere, with no Check for Updates; File › Open Records In with the current editor checked; and View › Tabs, with Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab owned by the menu and every tab command sent by ID.

title: Every focus has an ERD stage: a domain, an aggregate or an entity frames its own box, any other record its nearest entity or aggregate, or its domain or product
when: Works out the ERD focus of a domain, an aggregate, an entity, a use case, a command, its handler, an event, a table, a group, a Shared value object and the product, frames each on the laid-out map, then opens a use case and an aggregate.
then: Expects every focus to frame something on the one map; the ERD button pressed and enabled on a use case, the domain's boxes in focus; and Ctrl+2 and Alt+G switching an aggregate between the ERD and Graph stages.

title: The wiki card shows the focus's page, draws once where quick moves settle, collapses by Enter and its button, and keeps its width for the session
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage, steps right and down quickly with the arrow keys, presses Enter twice on the page, clicks the card's collapse button, moves its handle to End, opens another record and double-clicks the handle.
then: Expects the card on the use case's page with its title as an h2; after the quick steps the card not yet on the settled page, then on it; Enter hiding and showing the card and the collapse button hiding it with focus on the page bar's toggle, each saved in the session settings; the width 900 px saved, set on the layout and kept on the next record; and double-click resetting it.

title: In the browser, the wiki card never gets narrower than 360 px: as the window narrows it collapses for space first, and its title never breaks inside a word
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage at 1920 px and resizes the window to 1440, 1100, 960 and back to 1920 px.
then: Expects nothing collapsed in a wide window, the wiki card collapsed for space as the window narrows, and everything back at 1920 px; the card at least 360 px and the open space at least 300 px wherever they show; and no line of the card's title ending inside a word.

title: The wiki card sits in one spot under the tools, inset, its height a steady share of the stage, round, its whole border in the box's color, a lifting shadow and a quiet cross-fade
when: Reads the stylesheet.
then: Expects the card's top at the stage's tools' foot plus the card's own gap, with no glide and no bottom, its right inset by its gap; its height 60% of the stage as a summary and 85% expanded, each kept above the foot, with no height limit from its content; the sheet's radius, at least three times a box's, and a 2 px border all round in the focused box's color with no top stripe, the deeper shadow, the system's text color for the border under forced colors and the cross-fade only without reduced motion; and both gaps 28 px.

title: In the browser, the wiki card holds one spot under the toolbar, about 60% of the stage high as a summary and 85% expanded, whatever the focus
when: Opens an aggregate on the Graph stage at 1440 by 900 px, steps the focus right with the arrow keys, drags the stage up, then clicks More.
then: Expects the card's top just under the stage's toolbar and its height about 60% of the stage; its top, height and right edge unchanged after the new focus and the pan; and, expanded, its top unchanged and its height larger, at most about 85% of the stage and above the foot.

title: The Enter guard leaves a plain Enter with each control that handles it, and gives it to the wiki card everywhere else
when: Asks the guard about a link, a button, a summary, fields, editable text, the button, link, menu item, option, tab, checkbox, switch, tree item and grid cell roles, a menu, listbox, combobox, tree and grid with something inside, a modal dialog, a graph box, a scrolling region, text, a link with no address and the page.
then: Expects every control and what is inside the containers to keep Enter, and the graph box, the region, the text, the link with no address and the page to give it to the card.

title: Enter toggles the wiki card from the page and the focused box, focuses another box and stays with a button; Escape collapses it after what is above it
when: On a use case on the Graph stage, presses Enter twice on the page, twice on the focus's box, once on its capability's box and once on the stage switch's button; opens quick find, presses Escape in it, then Escape twice on the page.
then: Expects Enter on the page and on the focus's box to collapse and show the card, keyboard focus kept on the box; Enter on the capability's box to focus it with the card left open; the button's Enter to leave the card; the first Escape to close quick find only, the next to collapse the card, and the last to do nothing.

title: In the browser, Enter on the focused box toggles the wiki card, and Escape collapses it once quick find has closed
when: On a record page on the Graph stage, focuses the focus's box and presses Enter twice; opens quick find and presses Escape twice.
then: Expects the card collapsed and shown with keyboard focus kept on the box, quick find closed with the card still open after the first Escape, and the card collapsed and announced after the second.

title: A card page drawn or left mid-fade while the window is hidden ends its fade at once and shows whole
when: Draws a card page while the window is hidden; draws another while it is shown, then hides the window; then lets the page go and hides the window again.
then: Expects the first page's fade ended at once, the second's fade left running while shown and ended once hidden, and nothing ended after the page was let go.

title: The panels take the frosted surfaces, opaque under reduced transparency, and each says the side it floats on
when: Reads the stylesheet and opens a use case on the Graph stage.
then: Expects the dense and light surfaces to be the sheet's color at about 82% and 80% with a 22 px blur, the light one at least 78% and below the dense one, the sheet itself with no blur under reduced transparency, the wiki card and the dense panels to take their surface and the blur, and the nav, page bar, header strip and wiki card to float on the left, top, top and right; and text keeping 4.5:1 on the dense panels and 4.8:1 on the card in every built-in theme and mode, over every fill and dense content.

title: Stability: in a browser every panel blurs the stage behind a see-through surface, and draws opaque with no blur under reduced transparency
when: Opens a record on the Graph stage, reads each panel's computed backdrop filter and background, then emulates reduced transparency.
then: Expects the nav, page bar, header strip and wiki card each to blur with a translucent background, then each to draw no blur on an opaque background.

title: Performance: with every panel open, scrolling the wiki card moves no camera, and collapsing it recenters the graph within the camera move budget
when: Opens a record on the Graph stage with the wiki card open on the production build, scrolls the wiki card, then collapses it with w.
then: Expects no camera move from the scroll, and the glide that recenters the graph to take under the camera move budget of main-thread work.

title: The wiki card opens as a summary, More shows the whole page in place and Less goes back, the session's setting
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage in a new session, then clicks More and Less.
then: Expects the summary first: the kind line, the title as an h2, the goal and at most three facts, its capability first, with Edit and without the page's sections; after More the whole page with its flows and Edit, saved as expanded for the session; after Less the summary again, saved too.

title: The leader line runs from the focused box's nearest edge to the card, level with its title, or stubs toward a box out of view
when: Works out the line for a 100 by 40 box under three cameras, for a box spanning the title's row, a box running under a panel, boxes above, left of and past a corner of the open space, a box above with a tool row in the frame, and with no box, no card or no open space.
then: Expects the line from the box's nearest point to the card's inner edge at its title's row, slanting when they are not level; its start following a pan and a zoom while its end stays; a box under a panel starting at the open space's edge; a 28 px stub ending 12 px inside the frame's edge toward a box out of view; and no line with no box, no card or no open space.

title: In the browser, on the Graph, ERD and Trace stages, the leader line joins the focused box to the card's title, follows a pan, stubs for a box out of view and goes with the card
when: Opens an aggregate on the Graph and ERD stages and a use case on the Trace stage at 1440 px, drags the stage a little, then far, then presses Enter on the page; and opens the aggregate at phone width.
then: Expects the line to end on the card's inner edge within the title's row, its end unchanged and its start moved by the small pan, a stub after the far pan, no line once the card is collapsed, and no line on a phone.

title: In the browser, a pan of the Graph with the leader line drawn every frame stays within the camera-move budget
when: Opens an aggregate on the Graph stage with the wiki card open and drags the stage 80 px in 20 steps.
then: Expects the line drawn before and after the pan, and the pan's main-thread work within the camera-move budget (LA-PAT-APP-UX-R11).

title: In the wiki card's summary a long value wraps at the card's width, its label column only as wide as its labels
then: Expects the summary's fact rows to size the label column to its content and give the value the rest, and a record link in a value to flow inline.

title: History in the wiki card lists the commits that touched the record's rows, the uncommitted change first, shows a commit's diff inline, loads more, and says calmly when there is no git
when: Expands the wiki card with the history API answered in the test, and presses "Show the history".
then: Expects no history read before the button is pressed; then "Not committed" first and twenty commits with date, author and short hash; the uncommitted diff inline with its removed, added and header lines marked; one diff open at a time; Load more adding the rest; and the calm message when the folder is not a git repository.

title: A changed record's wiki card lists each field old → new and the links added and removed, an added one says New since its baseline, and the summary says it in a line
The Graph, the ERD and the Trace each show the lens, the baseline picker, Follow and the panel toggle in one place
Accessibility: the Changes controls and the Changes panel pass axe at WCAG 2.2 AA
Each stage marks added, changed and removed records, dots only under reduced motion, and the lens dims with the one fade without a new layout
Performance: marking 50 changes at once stays within the frame budget
The products picker is the space chooser
then: Expects one card per product with its ID, name and domain count, opening the product, and no problems or coverage.

title: Trace works on every focus: Ctrl+3 or the switch shows it, never disabled, on an obligation, above one, and on a record no chain holds
when: Switches an aggregate from the ERD to the Trace stage with Ctrl+3 and back with Alt+E, then opens a test, a flow step and a term on the Trace stage.
then: Expects the aggregate's matrix after Ctrl+3 and `?stage=erd` after Alt+E, and on each other record the Trace button pressed and enabled among Graph, ERD and Trace, with a trace drawn.

title: An obligation's chain holds what designs, builds and proves it, and the files they name, as the engine works it out
then: Expects a UC requirement's step, flow, view and command in design, the command's handler and the UI component rendering the view in build, its test, and their files; an invariant's aggregate and enforcing table; a constraint's value object and value type; a pattern rule's tests in each domain; and nothing for a record that is no obligation.

title: An obligation's Trace stage frames its lane: why first, an arrow for each link, the obligation centered
then: Expects the canvas ready with the requirement drawn as the focus; the capability, use case, requirement, flow, step, design, build, tests and files columns in that order; an arrow from the requirement to the flow, the flow to the step, the step to its view and command, the command to its handler, the requirement to its test and the handler and the test to their files; the requirement in the middle of the frame; and its kind and counts in the header strip.

title: A matrix has one row per obligation under the focus, in the nav's order, grouped by parent
then: Expects a use case's requirements under it, a domain's obligations grouped by their parents, a stage's and the product's too, and each of them drawn as a matrix.

title: A use case's and a domain's Trace stage frame them on the product's map, their lanes at full strength, the rest faded
then: Expects on a use case its tree box drawn as the focus and in view, as tall as its lanes, a lane per requirement under it at full strength, each joined to it by a level line, and the product's other lanes faded; on a domain every obligation under it at full strength and the rest faded; and the table's five columns with a heading row per parent.

title: A product's why tree starts at its outcomes, a capability serving several repeated under each; with none, at its capabilities
given: A product whose capability serves two business outcomes.
then: Expects the product's map to repeat the capability, with its use case and lanes, under each outcome, marked "Also serves" the other; an invariant to hang from its aggregate and a specification after the tree; a lane for every obligation; and, with no outcomes, the tree to start at the capability with no outcome column.

title: A row's gaps are the ones coverage reports: not designed, not built, not proved; a pattern rule owes proof only
then: Expects a fully traced requirement with no gap, an unproved requirement and invariant with a gap in tests, a specification with the design and build gaps coverage reports, and a pattern rule that owes proof only with its tests gap.

title: Empty cells show as gaps, the header strip counts them, and Gaps only keeps those rows and fades the other lanes
then: Expects gap cells in the warning style, the count of obligations and of those with gaps in the header strip, after Gaps only only the rows with a gap and on the canvas every lane still drawn, those with a gap at full strength and the rest faded, each gap a dashed box; then a note when no row has one.

title: A lane's gap is a dashed box in its column, and Gaps only fades the lanes with none
then: Expects a specification coverage reports not built and not proved to draw dashed gap boxes in the build and tests columns saying what is missing, none in its design; and under Gaps only every lane kept, those with a gap and the Untraced lane at full strength and the rest at the focus fade's.

title: Every cell links to its record and shows its ID, never wrapped, and its title; a file links to the record that names it
